title: What If You Were the Last Person on Earth?
style: stylized 3D animated film, cinematic CGI render, soft global illumination, volumetric light, rich detail, shallow depth of field, vertical composition
hero: a lone man in his thirties with short dark hair, wearing a dark green jacket and jeans

segments.text: What if you woke up tomorrow, and you were the last person on Earth?
shots: {hero} stands alone in the middle of a huge empty city avenue at sunrise, skyscrapers on both sides, no cars, no people, slow camera push in from behind him
close-up of {hero} looking around in disbelief on an empty street, golden morning light, gentle handheld camera

segments.text: No traffic. No queues. Every shop, every car, every house is yours.
shots: {hero} walks happily through an empty brightly lit supermarket aisle full of products, pushing a shopping cart, camera tracking alongside
{hero} opens the door of a shiny red sports car parked on an empty city street, smiling, camera slowly orbiting

segments.text: But owning everything is not the same as keeping it running.
shots: wide shot of a quiet empty city intersection, traffic lights blinking, {hero} small in the distance, slow dolly back

segments.text: With no one at the controls, the lights would likely go out within days.
shots: night city skyline, windows of skyscrapers turning off one block at a time until the city is dark, static wide camera
inside a huge empty power plant control room, rows of screens flicker and go dark, warning lights blink red, slow camera pan

segments.text: Subway pumps stop, and the tunnels slowly start to fill with water.
shots: an empty underground subway station, water rising slowly over the tracks, dim emergency lighting, slow camera push forward

segments.text: Food spoils. Fuel goes stale. Anything that breaks, you fix alone.
shots: {hero} sits on the floor of a dark kitchen lit only by an open empty fridge, holding a flashlight, tired
{hero} works alone on a car engine in an empty garage at dusk, sparks and a lamp, camera slowly circling

segments.text: Then the quiet gets louder. No one to call. No one to share a meal with.
shots: {hero} sits on a rooftop at night holding a phone with no signal, a dark city below, the Milky Way bright in the sky, slow crane up
{hero} eats alone at a long empty dining table in a big dim room, a single candle, static camera

segments.text: Researchers say real social connection matters for our health more than we think.
shots: warm glowing threads of light connecting many tiny houses across a dark landscape at night, then the lights fading one by one, slow aerial camera

segments.text: So you set the table for two. Just in case.
shots: {hero} gently places a second plate and a glass across the table from his own, warm candle light, slow push in
an empty chair with a set plate at a candlelit table, the window behind shows a dark city with the Milky Way, camera slowly pulls back

segments.text: Would you last a week? Tell me below, and follow for more what ifs.
shots: {hero} stands on a hill at dawn looking over an empty city slowly being overgrown by green plants, wind in the grass, slow camera push from behind
